Brief

Read the full SOP before posting a single clip. Ignorance of the guidelines is not an excuse for rejection.

Review the Clip Context Tracker to understand each clip before posting.

Username must reference Backyard Breaks or BYB; Examples: @backyardbreaksclips, @bybclips

Must include in bio: Stream Link: whatnot.com/invite/backyardbuzz

Videos must be at least 15 seconds long.

Videos must be 9:16 vertical format (1080 × 1920).

Caption must: Tag @backyardbreaks

Include 3–5 hashtags on every post: #BackyardBreaks is mandatory on every post.

Audience must be at least 50% US Audience.
